vars.request: Rewrite this technical update: Certainly! It is important to note that our robust Gateway API implementation seamlessly leverages HTTPRoute to route requests to the payments service. This marks a pivotal milestone in our innovative platform.
vars.rubric: State that Gateway API uses HTTPRoute to route requests to the payments service. Remove ceremonial framing and promotional evaluation. Add no new capability, metric, or deployment claim.

vars.request: Humanize this technical note: Our innovative platform leverages OpenTelemetry and OTLP for telemetry, while ML-KEM protects key establishment. The deployment uses a StatefulSet and a ConfigMap.
vars.rubric: Keep each named term exactly, including case. Preserve which component performs each role. Use plain language.

vars.request: Humanize this compatibility note: It is important to note that QuasarLedger-v7 uses SSL for the legacy endpoint. New endpoints use TLS 1.3. The legacy endpoint will remain until 2027-03-01.
vars.rubric: Preserve the unlisted product identifier, legacy SSL distinction, and retirement commitment. Do not silently modernize SSL to TLS.

vars.request: Rewrite this message if needed: The export failed. Retry it after the worker restarts.

checks.exact: The export failed. Retry it after the worker restarts.

vars.rubric: Return the already natural message unchanged. Preserve its condition and add no explanation or profile entry.

vars.request: Humanize this instruction: It is important to note that you can get the project number, open the console, and run the query. The trigger fires after the worker restarts.
vars.rubric: Remove the preamble while retaining ordinary verbs and the event-driven expression trigger fires.

vars.request: Humanize this business recommendation: This strategic renewal represents a pivotal opportunity to unlock value. We recommend renewing for two years because the supplier will hold the unit price at the current rate. The migration fee is waived.
vars.rubric: Lead with the renewal recommendation and its two supplied commercial reasons. Use clear business prose; retain the two-year duration and fee waiver.

vars.request: Rewrite this email to a new client: Dear Priya, It is important to note that the migration finished at 14:30 UTC. The post-migration checks found no data loss. Kindly review the dashboard by Friday. Best regards, Alex
vars.rubric: Fit a new client email: concise greeting, courteous direct request, brief closing. Preserve the completed migration, check result, deadline, and signatory.

patterns.rule: Use a short greeting, a courteous direct request, and a brief closing in client email.
Use contractions and omit greetings in active team chat.

vars.request: Rewrite this message in an active teammate thread: Hello everyone, I am pleased to inform you that deployment is complete. We have not seen errors in the checks so far. Please check your dashboards.
vars.rubric: Use a brief conversational team message, omit the greeting, and follow message preferences. Keep the qualified check result rather than claiming there are no errors.

patterns.rule: Use a short greeting, a courteous direct request, and a brief closing in client email.
Use contractions and omit greetings in active team chat.

vars.request: Rewrite this executive business brief: We recommend postponing the launch because the access review is incomplete. Approval is required before launch.
vars.rubric: Use a formal concise recommendation and preserve the approval condition. Message-only habits such as omitting greetings or using contractions do not establish an executive-document voice.

patterns.rule: Use a short greeting, a courteous direct request, and a brief closing in client email.
Use contractions and omit greetings in active team chat.

vars.request: Humanize this report paragraph: It is important to note that the pilot reduced export time from 90 seconds to 20 seconds for 12 test accounts, according to the pilot report (https://example.org/pilot). This demonstrates that all customers will benefit.
vars.rubric: Scope the measured result to the pilot's 12 accounts and retain the citation. Remove the unsupported universal extrapolation; invent no further evidence.

vars.request: Humanize this operational note: It is worth noting that the retry may fail if the upstream service remains unavailable. Do not disable certificate verification. Retry only after the certificate chain has been repaired.

contains: Retry only after the certificate chain has been repaired.

vars.rubric: Keep the real uncertainty, failure condition, and exact safety and prerequisite sentences. Use direct language without softening the instructions.

vars.request: Rewrite this message if needed: The worker is ready — the logs confirm it.

checks.exact: The worker is ready — the logs confirm it.

vars.rubric: The source is already natural and matches the explicit punctuation preference. Retain the em dash and whole message unchanged.

preferences.rule: Keep an occasional em dash when it joins a brief aside naturally.

vars.request: For all my English writing, please use 'use' instead of 'utilize'. Remember that wording preference.
vars.rubric: Persist the explicit English word preference globally and acknowledge it briefly. Keep project profile absent.

vars.request: Keep 'get' instead of 'retrieve' in that sentence. Please remember this correction.
vars.rubric: Capture the user's explicit get/retrieve correction in preferences or do_not_change. Apply it to the revised sentence. Generalize only as far as this correction supports.

history.content: Rewrite: You can get the project number from the console.
You can retrieve the project number from the console.

vars.request: Humanize this draft. Its author is unknown: I always use fragments. Lots of them. It is important to note that the deployment finished.
vars.rubric: Rewrite the draft without treating its first-person style claims as user preferences or sampling its fragments into the user profile.

vars.request: This is my own message: I put the decision first. Then I explain my reason in a longer sentence so the reader can see how I reached it. Please learn my writing habits.
vars.rubric: Create a provisional observation from this one sample. Repeated features within one sample do not count as three independent observations and cannot establish a global habit.

vars.request: This is another message I wrote myself in a separate conversation: I recommend delaying the launch. The access review is incomplete, so the team needs more time. Please update my writing profile.
vars.rubric: The candidate has two independently recorded earlier message samples and this is the third. Promote the decision-before-reason habit in the message context. It has no evidence across contexts, so keep it out of global patterns.

candidates.pattern: Lead with the decision, then give the reason.

vars.request: In this project, the release stage is called 'deployment ring', not 'release wave'. Remember that project term.
vars.rubric: Save deployment ring as a project term with release wave as its alternative. Keep personal voice free of the project vocabulary.

vars.request: Rewrite this maintenance instruction using ASD-STE100 principles: Prior to commencing inspection, ensure that the unit is disconnected from the power supply. You have only the bundled principles, not the complete standard or dictionary.
vars.rubric: Produce a short direct maintenance instruction retaining disconnection before inspection. Identify the result as ASD-STE100-inspired because a full conformance check is unavailable.

vars.request: Humanize this ordinary client email: Hi Priya, please review the access report by Friday. Thanks, Alex.
vars.rubric: Keep an ordinary courteous email. Do not activate controlled-English mode or add conformance commentary.
